subject: Request: short-term sandbox reinstatement and promotional grace for PoC
messages:
From: Danielle Soto <danielle.soto@novum.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Li <peter.li@novum.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term sandbox top-up for PoC - urgent

Hi Hannah,

Quick note from our side — we were onboarding Dev and QA teams for a 2-week PoC and hit an unexpected spike. Our sandbox credits expired yesterday and the team is blocked. Can Redwood provide a short-term top-up (enough for ~150k tokens) or a 7-day extension so we can finish the evaluation? The PoC showed promising latency numbers and the product team is close to approving a purchase, but we need one more sprint to complete feature validation.

I've attached a usage snapshot for the last two weeks and a draft PO we pulled together in case procurement wants to move fast. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Attachments: novum_usage_snapshot.csv (csv), po_purchase_draft.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Danielle Soto
Head of Platform Integrations
Novum AI

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Soto <danielle.soto@novum.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term sandbox top-up for PoC - urgent

Thanks for the context, Danielle — and congrats on the promising latency tests.

We can make a 7-day extension immediately and add a one-off trial top-up to cover ~175k tokens to give your team a buffer. Two quick notes:
- We require a written acknowledgment of the intended production timeline (simple one-sentence reply is fine) to tie the exception to the account.
- If procurement can sign the attached PO draft, we can convert the top-up to a committed pilot credit the same day (reduces administrative friction).

Jordan, fyi — can you confirm the extension and one-off top-up from the billing side and flag any constraints? Monica, please loop in CS for a quick runbook to get them unblocked.

Hannah
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Danielle Soto <danielle.soto@novum.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term sandbox top-up for PoC - urgent

On it. I can approve a one-time credit of 175,000 tokens and activate a 7-day expiry window as requested. I'll need Danielle to confirm two things in a reply: the intended go-live quarter (Q3 2028 or Q4 2028) and that Novum is the final payer on the PO. Once I have that I'll push the credit and send an updated usage summary.

I'll also add a note to the account: conditional pilot credits = true; conversion path = committed pilot -> reserved capacity evaluation.

-Jordan
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Danielle Soto <danielle.soto@novum.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Li <peter.li@novum.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2028 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term sandbox top-up for PoC - urgent

Jordan/Hannah — thanks, and yes to both items.

1) Go-live target: Q3 2028 (early September window).
2) Novum AI is the final payer on the PO — procurement will sign.

We've also confirmed an internal timeline shift: the feature flag rollouts need one additional test cycle which is why we asked for the buffer. If you can proceed with the 175k credit and 7-day extension, we'll proceed with the PO routing today. I'll share the signed PO to the DocuSign link you provided as soon as it's routed.

—Danielle

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Soto <danielle.soto@novum.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term sandbox top-up for PoC - urgent

Done — we've pushed a one-time 175,000 token credit to Novum's sandbox and set the expiry for 2028-06-27T23:59:59Z (7-day window). You should see an email confirmation in your console and the updated usage report attached. Please confirm when procurement uploads the signed PO and we'll queue the pilot conversion.

Attachments included: updated_usage_summary.csv (csv)

If you need more runway mid-cycle, let us know and we'll evaluate a short extension tied to the signed PO. Good luck with the final test cycle — happy to join any troubleshooting calls.

Best,
Hannah
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
